dedupe_keys.name: ems3d kitti synthetic emergency vehicle scenes

description: EMS3D-KITTI is a synthetic perception dataset focused on ambulances, police cars and surrounding road users. North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University researchers generated scenes in eight CARLA towns and converted camera, point-cloud, calibration and annotation outputs to KITTI format. The article describes four ego vehicles and collection of three thousand images with varied traffic, weather and human presence. Coverage is simulated environments, without geographic field observations or a real acquisition period. Zenodo publishes a single archive of about fifteen gigabytes free under CC BY 4.0. Synthetic appearance, CARLA behaviour and the deliberately increased emergency-vehicle presence limit interpretation as real traffic frequencies or demonstrated perception performance. Modellers could test emergency-vehicle detection within autonomous-driving simulations. model-sumo is a related traffic model, but it does not supply a verified importer for these sensor files. The archive was not downloaded, and the stated image count or distribution was not independently counted.
